note: The valley's other cats. Engine-neutral: homes name placement tags, places are derived from the world map, flight sites and thermals; nothing here adds geography. Looks live in shared/geometry/cat-folk/recipes.json. Needs run 0 (empty) to 1 (met).

gondola.verb: ride the gondola for the view

folk.bio: Elder of the meadow homes. Walks with a cane, tends herbs, keeps everyone's news.

greet: There you are, dear. Mind the herbs.
Well now. New face in the meadow.
Sit a while, if your legs will let you.
pass: Morning, {name}. I heard all about it.
chat: Now, {name}, you didn't hear this from me.
My knees say rain by evening.
Your mother did the very same thing, {name}.
Thyme for the cough. Always thyme.
blocked: Hm. Paths used to go through here.

folk.bio: A kitten who follows the pilots around and pounces on grasshoppers.

greet: Hi! Hi! Wanna race?
You're new! Can you pounce?
Bet you can't catch me!
chat: {name}, when can I fly?
I almost got one this big!
Why do clouds stay up, {name}?
Is it snack time?

folk.bio: Paraglider pilot. Reads the thermals off the ridge and lands on the green.

greet: Good air today. You fly?
Watch the ridge. It's working.
chat: The west face turned on early, {name}.
Took a collapse over the pines. Stayed calm.
You read it from the birds, {name}.
landed: Down. Want to go again already.

folk.bio: Teenage paramotor pilot. Launches from the meadow and never stays down long.

greet: Oh. Hey. Nice shoes, I guess.
You see me up there? Yeah, that was me.
chat: Motor's fine, {name}. It's meant to sound like that.
Ground's boring.
Don't tell anyone, {name}, but I buzzed the blimp.

folk.bio: Gardener. Carries a basket of greens between her beds and her neighbours.

greet: Hello, love! Take a carrot.
You look hungry. Everybody looks hungry.
chat: The beans came up lovely, {name}.
Slugs. Don't get me started.
I saved you the good lettuce, {name}.

folk.bio: Tinkerer who keeps the generator blimps flying, and tests parakites on the ridge.

greet: Hold this. No, wait. Never mind.
Do you know anything about bearings?
chat: It's the tension line, {name}. It's always the tension line.
I can fix that, {name}. Probably.
Efficiency's up two percent.

folk.bio: An elegant lady who walks slowly, watches the clouds and keeps the path gardens.

greet: Oh. Good day.
What a soft light, isn't it.
shy: If you would, a little room.
chat: That one looks like a heron, {name}.
I prefer the evenings.
One needn't hurry, {name}.

folk.bio: Fisher. Spends the afternoons on the river bank and shares the catch.

greet: They're biting today.
Quiet out here. Suits me.
chat: Had one this long, {name}. Honest.
River's low.
Patience, {name}. That's all it is.

folk.bio: Retired ferryman. Fishes the lake shallows and tells anyone who stops how the water used to run.

greet: Ah. Another one for the lake.
Sit. The fish aren't going anywhere.
chat: When I was your age, {name}, this was all river.
Trout come up at dusk. Always have.
Never trust a still pond, {name}.
blocked: The old path went round. Still does.

folk.bio: Lives up in the tree village. Swims the lake every morning and maps the coves in her satchel book.

greet: Oh! Have you been to the falls yet?
Hi! Race you to the water.
chat: I counted forty lilies in the west bay, {name}.
There's a trout bigger than Nubs, I swear.
Want to see my map, {name}?

folk.bio: The tree village's smallest climber. Never walks when a run will do.

greet: Tag! You're it!
Are you new? Are you fast?
chat: I can climb the whole trunk, {name}. Nearly.
Bree says ducks bite. Do ducks bite?
Can we go swimming, {name}?

folk.bio: Boat builder without a boat yet. Wades the outlet to read the current.

greet: Watch the current, it pulls left.
Good water today.
chat: A flat-bottom skiff, {name}. That's what this lake wants.
The outlet's faster than it looks.
Cedar floats, {name}. Pine sulks.
blocked: I'll go round by the moraine.

folk.bio: Pilot from the tree village. Launches from the north wall whenever the thermals come up.

greet: Feel that breeze? Lift by noon.
Up there is the only quiet place.
chat: Thermals off the granite, {name}. Every time.
Juno's the better teacher. Don't tell her.
The lake looks like a mirror from up there, {name}.

folk.bio: Keeps the lakeside gardens. Brings a basket of something to whoever looks hungry.

greet: Have a plum, dear. Go on.
Look at you. Have you eaten?
chat: The beans like the lake air, {name}.
Ume and I have been friends sixty years.
Never plant mint near anything you love, {name}.
blocked: My knees say the long way.

folk.bio: Carpenter of the tree village. Checks every bridge and stair before breakfast.

greet: Mind the third step, it creaks.
Solid as a trunk, this village.
chat: Redwood's patient, {name}. You build around it.
Juno borrowed my plane again.
Every knot tells you something, {name}.

folk.bio: Lives by the lake with a jingling collar. Follows dragonflies wherever they go.

greet: Did you see the dragonfly?
Hi! Play with me?
chat: Dragonflies have four wings, {name}. Four!
Nubs is my best friend.
Can you hear the frogs, {name}?
